keys.prompt:

Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. Match that identity exactly in every cell: silver-white rounded bob, one gray curved cowlick, violet headband with tiny white mascot, BLUE eyes with iris detail, pink top, fluffy lavender jacket with cream collar and long puffy cuffs. Warm blush, closely drawn hair sections, soft garment shading. Do not copy the florist character. The lower three-by-three reference supplies ONLY composition and sequential poses: crop head/shoulders similarly at the same relative scale. Exactly ONE silver-haired girl per cell, close-up, both small fists by cheeks. Match these nine LOWER pictures in order: half-lidded deadpan, little fists up, cheeks puff harder, tip markedly to screen RIGHT, settle through center, small counter-rock, let breath out with tiny O mouth, ease fists, return to first expression. Keep nine poses distinct with visible head swing.
